Software Engineer

Objective

Software Engineer with over 4 years of experience in developing software solutions and commercial applications. I am eager to join your company to build innovative, revenue-driving business solutions. In my previous roles, I maintained a 98% on-time project completion rate. My 3-year goal is to continue sharpening my technical and leadership skills, aiming to transition into a Team Lead position and contribute meaningfully to the company’s long-term growth.
